strings.text: After Nikolai Gogol's tale. Dikanka on Christmas Eve, the stolen moon, a flight to the Tsaritsa. A world for a bespoke game (docs/noch-pered-rozhdestvom).
strings.translation: Baseado no conto de Nikolai Gógol. Dikanka na véspera de Natal, a lua roubada, um voo até a czarina. Um mundo para um jogo bespoke (docs/noch-pered-rozhdestvom).
